_readme: commercetools pack knowledge. Both lists are a SEED (see _stamp): written from stable API-shape knowledge, to be re-verified per engagement against docs.commercetools.com for the project's region, API version and licensed products.

target_api_endpoint_families lists resource families relative to the project endpoint (https://api.<region>.commercetools.com/<projectKey>/...). Every resource is available in HTTP/REST and in GraphQL; writes go through the per-resource UPDATE ACTION catalogue with optimistic concurrency (version + 409), which is the contract a fit estimation must read.

target_content_component_types is deliberately NOT a list of platform content types: commercetools ships NO CMS. The entries name the few content-shaped platform primitives that do exist and then the external-CMS component types a project has to provide itself - each of those is custom work (CMS + binding + renderer), never covered-standard.
target_api_endpoint_families: /business-units (B2B company hierarchy) and /associate-roles (B2B permissions within a unit)
/types (custom-field definitions for any resource) and /custom-objects (untyped JSON store)
/states (lifecycle state machines for order, payment, review, product, quote)
/subscriptions (at-least-once, unordered), /extensions (synchronous hooks with a hard timeout), /messages (change messages per resource)
/graphql (the whole project model as one GraphQL endpoint)
auth host: POST /oauth/token (OAuth2 client credentials and password flows, scoped per project)
import host: Import API (import-containers, import-sinks for asynchronous bulk load)
target_content_component_types: NO native CMS - commercetools ships no page, template, slot, block or content-version resource
platform primitive: localized fields on catalog resources (name, description, slug, metaTitle, metaDescription)
platform primitive: Asset on ProductVariant / Category (images, videos, documents with localized labels)
platform primitive: Type-based custom fields (content attached to any resource, typed and validated)
platform primitive: CustomObject (untyped JSON container, often used as a stopgap content or configuration store)
platform primitive: ProductSelection (curated assortment per Store, the merchandising equivalent that does exist)
commercetools Frontend: page folder
commercetools Frontend: page template
commercetools Frontend: page version / preview
commercetools Frontend: tastic (frontend component bound to a data source)
commercetools Frontend: data source (query bound to a commercetools resource)
external CMS component: hero / banner
external CMS component: rich text / editorial block
external CMS component: media gallery, image, video
external CMS component: navigation menu and footer
external CMS component: landing / campaign page
external CMS component: curated product grid or slider bound to /product-projections/search
external CMS component: category or brand content page
external CMS component: content slot / experience fragment for personalisation
external CMS component: FAQ / accordion, teaser, CTA
external CMS component: form (contact, newsletter, request-a-quote)
external CMS component: SEO metadata and redirect management (no platform URL resolver beyond slugs)

_stamp.source: seed from general platform knowledge, to be verified
_stamp.verify_first: which CMS and which frontend the target architecture uses (the platform provides neither), whether commercetools Frontend and Checkout are licensed, the per-project limits and quotas for the region, the GA status of Product Search / search merchandising, and which back-office capabilities (order management, merchandising, CSR) are covered by a product rather than by custom work
